description: This Java class 'SearchAndEntityCollection' acts as a wrapper around a SearchQueryContributor object and a collection of entity classes to be searched within the OpenMRS system. It is used to contribute search predicates to search queries involving multiple entities.

classes.name: SearchAndEntityCollection
classes.description: A generic wrapper class that combines a SearchQueryContributor with a collection of entity classes for search operations.

methods.name: SearchAndEntityCollection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with a search query contributor and a collection of entity classes.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Delegates setting the final search predicate to the wrapped SearchQueryContributor.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the final predicate function from the wrapped SearchQueryContributor.

methods.name: getEntityCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of entity classes involved in the search.
